text:
matthew: hey @it-help — first day here, M2 MBP. Trying to enroll into Kandji but the enrollment fails at the network step with ‘Network config timed out (ENETDOWN)’. We use 802.1X + a proxy PAC on corp wifi. Any quick wins? :wave:

it-help: Welcome, matthew! :wave: Can you paste the exact error and your serial? Did you try Ethernet or a phone hotspot?

matthew: Popup says: "Enrollment failed: network config timed out (ENETDOWN)". Serial C02XYZ1234G7. I can tether phone but PAC is enforced on wifi and seems to block the bootstrap.

samir: We hit this with PAC/proxy where the device tries to call mdm.apple.com before proxy auth/session is applied. Short-term: hotspot or ethernet bypasses corp proxy. Longer: we push a PAC/exception for mdm endpoints during ABM staging.

it-help: If you can hotspot, try these commands after you connect: 

```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment || sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji enroll --serial C02XYZ1234G7
```
If that errors, grab the mdmclient logs: 

```
sudo log show --predicate 'process == "mdmclient"' --last 1h | tail -n 200
```

matthew: Pasted logs: https://pastebin.com/abc123 — I see TLS handshake -> 407 Proxy Authentication Required to mdm.apple.com. Not comfortable toggling proxy on the corp wifi. Could someone create a short-lived admin to finish enrollment?

alex: We can issue a one-time enrollment token and create a temp local admin. Need your employee ID and manager approval. @sarah-peopleops can you confirm?

sarah-peopleops: Confirmed — matthew is in Infra, manager approved temp admin for enrollment window. :white_check_mark:

alex: Ok created temp admin `temp-admin-214` with a 2-hour expiry. Temporary creds (shared securely): username temp-admin-214, password RwdTmp!2026. Steps: connect hotspot, then on the MBP open Terminal and run to create the account if not present:

```
sudo /usr/sbin/sysadminctl -addUser temp-admin-214 -fullName 'Temp Admin' -password 'RwdTmp!2026' -admin
```
After enrollment remove it: 

```
sudo /usr/sbin/sysadminctl -deleteUser temp-admin-214
```

matthew: Using hotspot + the temp admin worked — Kandji enrolled and FileVault kicked off the first encrypt. Thanks! How do I verify recovery key escrow?

it-help: Kandji escrows FV keys to our KMS automatically. Check Kandji Console -> Devices -> look up the device (serial/C02XYZ1234G7) -> Disk Encryption section should show `Escrowed: yes`. If it shows no, ping us and we’ll re-run escrow.

matthew: Confirmed `Escrowed: yes`. One more thing: macOS prompted for a system extension approval during an installer for a VPN agent referencing Hypervisor.framework. Should I allow it?

danielle: Don’t grant unsigned kernel extensions. If this is the Apple Hypervisor.framework (Apple-signed) it’s ok. If the installer asks for a third-party kernel extension or system extension named like `AcmeVPN` that’s a red flag — ping security.

security-bot: Policy note: Do not manually approve kernel extensions outside SRE/infosec process. Open an internal ticket if an installer is blocked; we’ll verify and provision a signed profile if approved.

matthew: All set now, thanks everyone! :tada:
